name: Speaker Calibrator (PulseAudio)
author: Michael de By (Omaxian port)
description: Measure with one or many microphones and generate adaptive, repeat-validated, protected parametric speaker tuning (PulseAudio DSP only).

barWidget.description: PulseAudio only. Calibrate speakers with a userspace DSP; use the PipeWire plugin on PipeWire hosts.
